reviews: Order at the counter, burger in your hand in five minutes. Perfect between lectures, and it barely dents your wallet.
Their black bean patty is honestly better than most beef ones. My veggie friend ordered two.
Walk up, grab a brisket burger, walk out. Fastest cheap lunch on campus.
It's meat, meat and more meat. Even the fries are cooked in beef fat, so my vegetarian roommate just watched me eat.
Cheap burgers with a really solid mushroom-and-lentil veggie patty. Great if you've got the whole evening.
Proper table service: you get seated, wait for a menu, wait for your food, wait for the bill. Don't come here on a short break.
Still my go-to basement noodle bar. No windows, but you're in and out in fifteen minutes for a few bucks.
Plenty of tofu and veggie broth bowls. Strictly noodles though, so don't come in craving a burger.
